attorneys: Mr. Frederick A. Henry for plaintiff in error., Messrs. Wm. H. Boyd and Thomas H. Hogsett, with whom Mr. Leslie Nichols ■ was' on the brief, for defendant in error. See post, p. 578.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam:

The writ of error is dismissed for want of a substantial federal' question on the authority of Shulthis v. McDougal, 225 U. S. 561, 569; Hull v. Burr, 234 U. S. 712, 720; Norton v. Whiteside, 239 U. S. 144, 147.
